rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial noun for a humiliating disgrace or loss of face.

example.english: This time was really a disgrace.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 gaa2

rows.note: Choose this for a shameful act, incident, or affair rather than mainly for the person involved.

example.english: Everyone in the neighborhood knew about this disgrace.
example.traditional: 呢單醜事傳到成個街坊都知。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 cau2 si6 cyun4 dou3 seng4 go3 gaai1 fong1 dou1 zi1

rows.note: Choose this formal noun when a person or thing is described as a dishonour or disgrace to others.

example.english: Their actions are a disgrace to the company.
example.traditional: 佢哋嘅所作所為，對公司嚟講係恥辱。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ge3 so2 zok3 so2 wai4 deoi3 gung1 si1 lei4 gong2 hai6 ci2 juk6

rows.note: Choose this for a disgrace understood as a lasting stain on someone's reputation or record.

example.english: This incident became a lasting disgrace on his record.
example.traditional: 呢件事成為佢履歷上嘅污點。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 sing4 wai4 keoi5 lei5 lik6 soeng6 ge3 wu1 dim2
